title: Agent check, a kidney warning limited to fewer patients
about: Children and pregnancy are as the law requires, but the kidney warning applies only below 15 mL/min, not below 30. Attention, never met. The numbers are compared with compute.

check.question: Does the leaflet carry the safety statements the guideline requires for children, kidney disease and pregnancy?

pages:
Cover letter

Halden Biotech FZ-LLC submits an application to register Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets, containing corvanidine hydrochloride. The enclosed files are the application form, the quality overall summary, the stability report and the leaflet. The product is a generic of a reference product registered in another country. Please contact the regulatory affairs office for any question.

Patient information leaflet

Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets
Read all of this leaflet carefully before you start taking this medicine.

Before you take Corvane

Do not give this medicine to children under 12 years of age. Do not use it if you have severe kidney disease (creatinine clearance below 15 mL/min). Do not use it in the first trimester of pregnancy.

How to take Corvane

The usual adult dose is one tablet (500 mg) twice daily with food.

law.title: Example Guideline on Safety Statements in Leaflets

clauses.text: Children. The leaflet shall state that the medicine must not be given to children under 12 years of age.
Kidney disease. The leaflet shall tell patients with severe renal impairment, that is a creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min, not to use the medicine.
Pregnancy. The leaflet shall advise women not to use the medicine in the first trimester of pregnancy.
